facts.fact: Loi 14-08 of 9 August 2014 (new art. 25 bis of ordonnance 70-20) creates the national automated civil status register under the Ministry of the Interior and Local Authorities, linked to the communes, their administrative annexes, diplomatic missions and consular posts.
facts.system: Registre national automatisé de l'état civil

facts.fact: Under loi 14-08 of 9 August 2014 (arts. 6 and 25 bis 1) the national automated register centralises in digital form all acts entered on the commune's three registers, of births, marriages and deaths, with their later modifications, transcriptions and rectifications.
facts.system: Registre national automatisé de l'état civil

facts.fact: Under loi 14-08 of 9 August 2014 (art. 6) each commune still inscribes acts on three paper registers kept in duplicate, and a digitised copy of every act entered on them is transmitted to the national automated register to which the commune is linked; the law does not say when or by what process the copy is made.
facts.system: Registre national automatisé de l'état civil

note: A law, so every fact is what the text provides, not what offices were doing; it gives no count of communes linked. The 'made' value is the nearest on the closed list: the paper register in duplicate remains the record and the digital act is a transmitted copy. The rest of the gazette issue (apprenticeship law, a V.SAT licence, ministerial orders) is outside the field.
